consultasBanco.descricao: RDO: original preservado + correção (supersedes_id) e índice único (obra, data, turno)
consultasBanco.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM construction.daily_reports WHERE id = $1)::int AS original, (SELECT count(*) FROM construction.daily_reports WHERE supersedes_id = $1)::int AS correcoes, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'construction' AND tablename = 'daily_reports' AND indexdef ILIKE '%UNIQUE%' AND indexdef ILIKE '%shift_code%')::int AS indice_unico
